description: Construction of a new railway bridge across the Mahaweli River between Sarasavi Uyana and Peradeniya of the Matale railway line
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A project has been planned to be implemented to develop an extensive suburban railway network covering the Kandy Municipal Area, and a feasibility study in this regard is currently underway. The scope of the said project includes the construction of a double-track railway line of the main railway line from Kadugannawa to Gampola (via Peradeniya) and double-tracking of the Matale Railway Line from Peradeniya to Katugastota. It has been identified that measures should be taken under the said project to complete the planned double-track railway line, eliminate the existing single-track bottleneck and enhance the reliability and connectivity of the railway network. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to construct a new railway bridge across the Mahaweli River between Sarasavi Uyana and Peradeniya, obtaining financial assistance from the Indian Line of Credit allocated for the reconstruction and development of railway infrastructure damaged by Cyclone Ditwah, enabling to integrate the Matale railway line with the national railway network.
